verses.original: וַיַּ֣רְא יַעֲקֹ֔ב כִּ֥י יֶשׁ־ שֶׁ֖בֶר בְּמִצְרָ֑יִם וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יַעֲקֹב֙ לְבָנָ֔יו לָ֖מָּה תִּתְרָאֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar ya·‘ă·qōḇ kî yeš- še·ḇer bə·miṣ·rā·yim way·yō·mer ya·‘ă·qōḇ lə·ḇā·nāw lām·māh tiṯ·rā·’ū
verses.literal: When Jacob learned that there was grain in Egypt he said to his sons Why are you staring at one another
verses.literalPt: VENDO então Jacó que havia mantimento no Egito, disse a seus filhos: Por que estais olhando uns para os outros?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר הִנֵּ֣ה שָׁמַ֔עְתִּי כִּ֥י יֶשׁ־ שֶׁ֖בֶר בְּמִצְרָ֑יִם רְדוּ־ שָׁ֙מָּה֙ וְשִׁבְרוּ־ לָ֣נוּ מִשָּׁ֔ם וְנִחְיֶ֖ה וְלֹ֥א נָמֽוּת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer hin·nêh šā·ma‘·tî kî yeš- še·ḇer bə·miṣ·rā·yim rə·ḏū- šām·māh wə·šiḇ·rū- lā·nū miš·šām wə·niḥ·yeh wə·lō nā·mūṯ
verses.literal: Look he added I have heard that there is grain in Egypt Go down there and buy some for us . . . so that we may live and not die
verses.literalPt: Disse mais: Eis que tenho ouvido que há mantimentos no Egito; descei para lá, e comprai-nos dali, para que vivamos e não morramos.

verses.original: וַיֵּרְד֥וּ אֲחֵֽי־ יוֹסֵ֖ף עֲשָׂרָ֑ה לִשְׁבֹּ֥ר בָּ֖ר מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·rə·ḏū ’ă·ḥê- yō·w·sêp̄ ‘ă·śā·rāh liš·bōr bār mim·miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: So ten of Joseph’s brothers went down to buy grain from Egypt
verses.literalPt: Então desceram os dez irmãos de José, para comprarem trigo no Egito.

verses.original: וְאֶת־ בִּנְיָמִין֙ אֲחִ֣י יוֹסֵ֔ף לֹא־ שָׁלַ֥ח יַעֲקֹ֖ב אֶת־ אֶחָ֑יו כִּ֣י אָמַ֔ר פֶּן־ יִקְרָאֶ֖נּוּ אָסֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- bin·yā·mîn ’ă·ḥî yō·w·sêp̄ lō- šā·laḥ ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’eṯ- ’e·ḥāw kî ’ā·mar pen- yiq·rā·’en·nū ’ā·sō·wn
verses.literal: But Jacob did not send Joseph’s brother Benjamin with his brothers for he said I am afraid that harm might befall him
verses.literalPt: A Benjamim, porém, irmão de José, não enviou Jacó com os seus irmãos, porque dizia: Para que lhe não suceda, porventura, algum desastre.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לִשְׁבֹּ֖ר בְּת֣וֹךְ הַבָּאִ֑ים כִּֽי־ הָיָ֥ה הָרָעָ֖ב בְּאֶ֥רֶץ כְּנָֽעַן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl liš·bōr bə·ṯō·wḵ hab·bā·’îm kî- hā·yāh hā·rā·‘āḇ bə·’e·reṣ kə·nā·‘an
verses.literal: So the sons of Israel were among those who came to buy grain since the famine had also spread to the land of Canaan
verses.literalPt: Assim, entre os que iam lá foram os filhos de Israel para comprar, porque havia fome na terra de Canaã.

verses.original: וְיוֹסֵ֗ף ה֚וּא הַשַּׁלִּ֣יט עַל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ ה֥וּא הַמַּשְׁבִּ֖יר לְכָל־ עַ֣ם הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ אֲחֵ֣י יוֹסֵ֔ף וַיִּשְׁתַּֽחֲווּ־ ל֥וֹ אַפַּ֖יִם אָֽרְצָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yō·w·sêp̄ hū haš·šal·lîṭ ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ hū ham·maš·bîr lə·ḵāl ‘am hā·’ā·reṣ way·yā·ḇō·’ū ’ă·ḥê yō·w·sêp̄ way·yiš·ta·ḥă·wū- lōw ’ap·pa·yim ’ā·rə·ṣāh
verses.literal: Now Joseph was the ruler of the land he was the one who sold grain to all its people So when his brothers arrived they bowed down before him with their faces to the ground
verses.literalPt: José, pois, era o governador daquela terra; ele vendia a todo o povo da terra; e os irmãos de José chegaram e inclinaram-se a ele, com o rosto em terra.

verses.original: וַיַּ֥רְא יוֹסֵ֛ף אֶת־ אֶחָ֖יו וַיַּכִּרֵ֑ם וַיִּתְנַכֵּ֨ר אֲלֵיהֶ֜ם וַיְדַבֵּ֧ר אִתָּ֣ם קָשׁ֗וֹת וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵהֶם֙ מֵאַ֣יִן בָּאתֶ֔ם וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ כְּנַ֖עַן לִשְׁבָּר־ אֹֽכֶל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar yō·w·sêp̄ ’eṯ- ’e·ḥāw way·yak·ki·rêm way·yiṯ·nak·kêr ’ă·lê·hem way·ḏab·bêr ’it·tām qā·šō·wṯ way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem mê·’a·yin bā·ṯem way·yō·mə·rū mê·’e·reṣ kə·na·‘an liš·bār- ’ō·ḵel
verses.literal: And when Joseph saw his brothers he recognized them but he treated them as strangers . . . and spoke harshly to them Where have you come from he asked . . . From the land of Canaan they replied We are here to buy food
verses.literalPt: E José, vendo os seus irmãos, conheceu-os; porém mostrou-se estranho para com eles, e falou-lhes asperamente, e disse-lhes: De onde vindes? E eles disseram: Da terra de Canaã, para comprarmos mantimento.

verses.original: וַיַּכֵּ֥ר יוֹסֵ֖ף אֶת־ אֶחָ֑יו וְהֵ֖ם לֹ֥א הִכִּרֻֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yak·kêr yō·w·sêp̄ ’eṯ- ’e·ḥāw wə·hêm lō hik·ki·ru·hū
verses.literal: Although Joseph recognized his brothers they did not recognize him
verses.literalPt: José, pois, conheceu os seus irmãos; mas eles não o conheceram.

verses.original: וַיִּזְכֹּ֣ר יוֹסֵ֔ף אֵ֚ת הַחֲלֹמ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָלַ֖ם לָהֶ֑ם וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵהֶם֙ מְרַגְּלִ֣ים אַתֶּ֔ם לִרְא֛וֹת אֶת־ עֶרְוַ֥ת הָאָ֖רֶץ בָּאתֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiz·kōr yō·w·sêp̄ ’êṯ ha·ḥă·lō·mō·wṯ ’ă·šer ḥā·lam lā·hem way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem mə·rag·gə·lîm ’at·tem lir·’ō·wṯ ’eṯ- ‘er·waṯ hā·’ā·reṣ bā·ṯem
verses.literal: Joseph remembered his dreams - about them and said . . . You are spies You have come to see if our land is vulnerable
verses.literalPt: Então José lembrou-se dos sonhos que havia tido deles e disse-lhes: Vós sois espias, e viestes para ver a nudez da terra.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֥וּ אֵלָ֖יו לֹ֣א אֲדֹנִ֑י וַעֲבָדֶ֥יךָ בָּ֖אוּ לִשְׁבָּר־ אֹֽכֶל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū ’ê·lāw lō ’ă·ḏō·nî wa·‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā bā·’ū liš·bār- ’ō·ḵel
verses.literal: Not so my lord they replied . . . Your servants have come to buy food
verses.literalPt: E eles lhe disseram: Não, senhor meu; mas teus servos vieram comprar mantimento.

verses.original: כֻּלָּ֕נוּ בְּנֵ֥י אִישׁ־ אֶחָ֖ד נָ֑חְנוּ כֵּנִ֣ים אֲנַ֔חְנוּ לֹא־ הָי֥וּ עֲבָדֶ֖יךָ מְרַגְּלִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kul·lā·nū bə·nê ’îš- ’e·ḥāḏ nā·ḥə·nū kê·nîm ’ă·naḥ·nū lō- hā·yū ‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā mə·rag·gə·lîm
verses.literal: We are all sons of one man Your servants . . . are honest men not spies
verses.literalPt: Todos nós somos filhos de um mesmo homem; somos homens de retidão; os teus servos não são espias.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֑ם לֹ֕א כִּֽי־ עֶרְוַ֥ת הָאָ֖רֶץ בָּאתֶ֥ם לִרְאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem lō kî- ‘er·waṯ hā·’ā·reṣ bā·ṯem lir·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: No . . . he told them You have come to see if our land is vulnerable
verses.literalPt: E ele lhes disse: Não; antes viestes para ver a nudez da terra.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֗וּ שְׁנֵ֣ים עָשָׂר֩ עֲבָדֶ֨יךָ אַחִ֧ים׀ אֲנַ֛חְנוּ בְּנֵ֥י אִישׁ־ אֶחָ֖ד בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן וְהִנֵּ֨ה הַקָּטֹ֤ן אֶת־ אָבִ֙ינוּ֙ הַיּ֔וֹם וְהָאֶחָ֖ד אֵינֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū šə·nêm ‘ā·śār ‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā ’a·ḥîm ’ă·naḥ·nū bə·nê ’îš- ’e·ḥāḏ bə·’e·reṣ kə·nā·‘an wə·hin·nêh haq·qā·ṭōn ’eṯ- ’ā·ḇî·nū hay·yō·wm wə·hā·’e·ḥāḏ ’ê·nen·nū
verses.literal: But they answered Your servants . . . are twelve . . . brothers the sons of one man in the land of Canaan . . . The youngest is now with our father and one is no more
verses.literalPt: E eles disseram: Nós, teus servos, somos doze irmãos, filhos de um homem na terra de Canaã; e eis que o mais novo está com nosso pai hoje; mas um já não existe.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֖ם יוֹסֵ֑ף ה֗וּא אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבַּ֧רְתִּי אֲלֵכֶ֛ם לֵאמֹ֖ר מְרַגְּלִ֥ים אַתֶּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem yō·w·sêp̄ hū ’ă·šer dib·bar·tî ’ă·lê·ḵem lê·mōr mə·rag·gə·lîm ’at·tem
verses.literal: Then Joseph . . . declared . . . Just as I said . . . . . . you are spies
verses.literalPt: Então lhes disse José: Isso é o que vos tenho dito, sois espias;

verses.original: בְּזֹ֖את תִּבָּחֵ֑נוּ חֵ֤י פַרְעֹה֙ אִם־ תֵּצְא֣וּ מִזֶּ֔ה כִּ֧י אִם־ בְּב֛וֹא אֲחִיכֶ֥ם הַקָּטֹ֖ן הֵֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: bə·zōṯ tib·bā·ḥê·nū ḥê p̄ar·‘ōh ’im- tê·ṣə·’ū miz·zeh kî ’im- bə·ḇō·w ’ă·ḥî·ḵem haq·qā·ṭōn hên·nāh
verses.literal: And this is how you will be tested As surely as Pharaoh lives you shall not leave this place unless . . . your youngest brother comes here
verses.literalPt: Nisto sereis provados; pela vida de Faraó, não saireis daqui senão quando vosso irmão mais novo vier aqui.

verses.original: שִׁלְח֨וּ מִכֶּ֣ם אֶחָד֮ וְיִקַּ֣ח אֶת־ אֲחִיכֶם֒ וְאַתֶּם֙ הֵאָ֣סְר֔וּ וְיִבָּֽחֲנוּ֙ דִּבְרֵיכֶ֔ם הַֽאֱמֶ֖ת אִתְּכֶ֑ם וְאִם־ לֹ֕א חֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֔ה כִּ֥י מְרַגְּלִ֖ים אַתֶּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: šil·ḥū mik·kem ’e·ḥāḏ wə·yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- ’ă·ḥî·ḵem wə·’at·tem hê·’ā·sə·rū wə·yib·bā·ḥă·nū diḇ·rê·ḵem ha·’ĕ·meṯ ’it·tə·ḵem wə·’im- lō ḥê p̄ar·‘ōh kî mə·rag·gə·lîm ’at·tem
verses.literal: Send one of your number to get your brother the rest of you will be confined so that the truth of your words may be tested . . . If they are untrue then as surely as Pharaoh . . . lives you are spies
verses.literalPt: Enviai um dentre vós, que traga vosso irmão, mas vós ficareis presos, e vossas palavras sejam provadas, se há verdade convosco; e se não, pela vida de Faraó, vós sois espias.

verses.original: וַיֶּאֱסֹ֥ף אֹתָ֛ם אֶל־ מִשְׁמָ֖ר שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת יָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·ye·’ĕ·sōp̄ ’ō·ṯām ’el- miš·mār šə·lō·šeṯ yā·mîm
verses.literal: So Joseph imprisoned them - . . . for three days
verses.literalPt: E pô-los juntos, em prisão, três dias.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֤ם יוֹסֵף֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י זֹ֥את עֲשׂ֖וּ וִֽחְי֑וּ אֶת־ הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים אֲנִ֥י יָרֵֽא׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem yō·w·sêp̄ bay·yō·wm haš·šə·lî·šî zōṯ ‘ă·śū wiḥ·yū ’eṯ- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·nî yā·rê
verses.literal: and on the third day he said to them I fear God So do this and you will live
verses.literalPt: E ao terceiro dia disse-lhes José: Fazei isso, e vivereis; porque eu temo a Deus.

verses.original: אִם־ כֵּנִ֣ים אַתֶּ֔ם אֲחִיכֶ֣ם אֶחָ֔ד יֵאָסֵ֖ר בְּבֵ֣ית מִשְׁמַרְכֶ֑ם וְאַתֶּם֙ לְכ֣וּ הָבִ֔יאוּ שֶׁ֖בֶר רַעֲב֥וֹן בָּתֵּיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- kê·nîm ’at·tem ’ă·ḥî·ḵem ’e·ḥāḏ yê·’ā·sêr bə·ḇêṯ miš·mar·ḵem wə·’at·tem lə·ḵū hā·ḇî·’ū še·ḇer ra·‘ă·ḇō·wn bāt·tê·ḵem
verses.literal: If you . . . are honest leave one of your brothers in custody . . . . . . while the rest of you go and take back grain to relieve the hunger of your households
verses.literalPt: Se sois homens de retidão, que fique um de vossos irmãos preso na casa de vossa prisão; e vós ide, levai mantimento para a fome de vossa casa,

verses.original: וְאֶת־ אֲחִיכֶ֤ם הַקָּטֹן֙ תָּבִ֣יאוּ אֵלַ֔י וְיֵאָמְנ֥וּ דִבְרֵיכֶ֖ם וְלֹ֣א תָמ֑וּתוּ וַיַּעֲשׂוּ־ כֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- ’ă·ḥî·ḵem haq·qā·ṭōn tā·ḇî·’ū ’ê·lay wə·yê·’ā·mə·nū ḏiḇ·rê·ḵem wə·lō ṯā·mū·ṯū way·ya·‘ă·śū- ḵên
verses.literal: Then bring your youngest brother to me so that your words can be verified that you may not die And to this they consented
verses.literalPt: E trazei-me o vosso irmão mais novo, e serão verificadas vossas palavras, e não morrereis. E eles assim fizeram.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֞וּ אִ֣ישׁ אֶל־ אָחִ֗יו אֲבָל֮ אֲשֵׁמִ֣ים׀ אֲנַחְנוּ֮ עַל־ אָחִינוּ֒ אֲשֶׁ֨ר רָאִ֜ינוּ צָרַ֥ת נַפְשׁ֛וֹ בְּהִתְחַֽנְנ֥וֹ אֵלֵ֖ינוּ וְלֹ֣א שָׁמָ֑עְנוּ עַל־ כֵּן֙ בָּ֣אָה אֵלֵ֔ינוּ הַצָּרָ֖ה הַזֹּֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū ’îš ’el- ’ā·ḥîw ’ă·ḇāl ’ă·šê·mîm ’ă·naḥ·nū ‘al- ’ā·ḥî·nū ’ă·šer rā·’î·nū ṣā·raṯ nap̄·šōw bə·hiṯ·ḥan·nōw ’ê·lê·nū wə·lō šā·mā·‘ə·nū ‘al- kên bā·’āh ’ê·lê·nū haṣ·ṣā·rāh haz·zōṯ
verses.literal: Then they said to one another Surely we are being punished because of our brother We saw his anguish when he pleaded with us but we would not listen That is why . . . this distress has come upon us
verses.literalPt: Então disseram uns aos outros: Na verdade, somos culpados acerca de nosso irmão, pois vimos a angústia da sua alma, quando nos rogava; nós porém não ouvimos, por isso vem sobre nós esta angústia.

verses.original: וַיַּעַן֩ רְאוּבֵ֨ן אֹתָ֜ם לֵאמֹ֗ר הֲלוֹא֩ אָמַ֨רְתִּי אֲלֵיכֶ֧ם׀ לֵאמֹ֛ר אַל־ תֶּחֶטְא֥וּ בַיֶּ֖לֶד וְלֹ֣א שְׁמַעְתֶּ֑ם וְגַם־ דָּמ֖וֹ הִנֵּ֥ה נִדְרָֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an rə·’ū·ḇên ’ō·ṯām lê·mōr hă·lō·w ’ā·mar·tî ’ă·lê·ḵem lê·mōr ’al- te·ḥeṭ·’ū ḇay·ye·leḏ wə·lō šə·ma‘·tem wə·ḡam- dā·mōw hin·nêh niḏ·rāš
verses.literal: And Reuben responded Didn’t . . . . . . . . . I tell you not to sin against the boy But you would not listen . . . Now we must account for his blood
verses.literalPt: E Rúben respondeu-lhes, dizendo: Não vo-lo dizia eu: Não pequeis contra o menino; mas não ouvistes; e vedes aqui, o seu sangue também é requerido.

verses.original: וְהֵם֙ לֹ֣א יָֽדְע֔וּ כִּ֥י שֹׁמֵ֖עַ יוֹסֵ֑ף כִּ֥י הַמֵּלִ֖יץ בֵּינֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hêm lō yā·ḏə·‘ū kî šō·mê·a‘ yō·w·sêp̄ kî ham·mê·lîṣ bê·nō·ṯām
verses.literal: They did not realize that Joseph understood them since there was an interpreter between them
verses.literalPt: E eles não sabiam que José os entendia, porque havia intérprete entre eles.

verses.original: וַיִּסֹּ֥ב מֵֽעֲלֵיהֶ֖ם וַיֵּ֑בְךְּ וַיָּ֤שָׁב אֲלֵהֶם֙ וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵהֶ֔ם וַיִּקַּ֤ח מֵֽאִתָּם֙ אֶת־ שִׁמְע֔וֹן וַיֶּאֱסֹ֥ר אֹת֖וֹ לְעֵינֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yis·sōḇ mê·‘ă·lê·hem way·yê·ḇək way·yā·šāḇ ’ă·lê·hem way·ḏab·bêr ’ă·lê·hem way·yiq·qaḥ mê·’it·tām ’eṯ- šim·‘ō·wn way·ye·’ĕ·sōr ’ō·ṯōw lə·‘ê·nê·hem
verses.literal: And he turned away from them and wept When he turned back and spoke . . . to them he took Simeon from them and had him bound before their eyes
verses.literalPt: E retirou-se deles e chorou. Depois tornou a eles, e falou-lhes, e tomou a Simeão dentre eles, e amarrou-o perante os seus olhos.

verses.original: וַיְצַ֣ו יוֹסֵ֗ף וַיְמַלְא֣וּ אֶת־ כְּלֵיהֶם֮ בָּר֒ וּלְהָשִׁ֤יב כַּסְפֵּיהֶם֙ אִ֣ישׁ אֶל־ שַׂקּ֔וֹ וְלָתֵ֥ת לָהֶ֛ם צֵדָ֖ה לַדָּ֑רֶךְ וַיַּ֥עַשׂ לָהֶ֖ם כֵּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·ṣaw yō·w·sêp̄ way·mal·’ū ’eṯ- kə·lê·hem bār ū·lə·hā·šîḇ kas·pê·hem ’îš ’el- śaq·qōw wə·lā·ṯêṯ lā·hem ṣê·ḏāh lad·dā·reḵ way·ya·‘aś lā·hem kên
verses.literal: Then Joseph gave orders to fill their bags with grain to return each man’s silver to his sack and to give them provisions for their journey This order was carried out
verses.literalPt: E ordenou José, que enchessem os seus sacos de trigo, e que lhes restituíssem o seu dinheiro a cada um no seu saco, e lhes dessem comida para o caminho; e fizeram-lhes assim.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׂא֥וּ אֶת־ שִׁבְרָ֖ם עַל־ חֲמֹרֵיהֶ֑ם וַיֵּלְכ֖וּ מִשָּֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiś·’ū ’eṯ- šiḇ·rām ‘al- ḥă·mō·rê·hem way·yê·lə·ḵū miš·šām
verses.literal: and they loaded the grain on their donkeys and departed . . .
verses.literalPt: E carregaram o seu trigo sobre os seus jumentos e partiram dali.

verses.original: וַיִּפְתַּ֨ח הָאֶחָ֜ד אֶת־ שַׂקּ֗וֹ לָתֵ֥ת מִסְפּ֛וֹא לַחֲמֹר֖וֹ בַּמָּל֑וֹן וַיַּרְא֙ אֶת־ כַּסְפּ֔וֹ וְהִנֵּה־ ה֖וּא בְּפִ֥י אַמְתַּחְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yip̄·taḥ hā·’e·ḥāḏ ’eṯ- śaq·qōw lā·ṯêṯ mis·pō·w la·ḥă·mō·rōw bam·mā·lō·wn way·yar ’eṯ- kas·pōw wə·hin·nêh- hū bə·p̄î ’am·taḥ·tōw
verses.literal: At the place where they lodged for the night one of them opened his sack to get feed for his donkey and he saw his silver . . . . . . in the mouth of the sack
verses.literalPt: E, abrindo um deles o seu saco, para dar pasto ao seu jumento na estalagem, viu o seu dinheiro; porque eis que estava na boca do seu saco.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֶל־ אֶחָיו֙ הוּשַׁ֣ב כַּסְפִּ֔י וְגַ֖ם הִנֵּ֣ה בְאַמְתַּחְתִּ֑י וַיֵּצֵ֣א לִבָּ֗ם וַיֶּֽחֶרְד֞וּ אִ֤ישׁ אֶל־ אָחִיו֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר מַה־ זֹּ֛את עָשָׂ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֖ים לָֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’el- ’e·ḥāw hū·šaḇ kas·pî wə·ḡam hin·nêh ḇə·’am·taḥ·tî way·yê·ṣê lib·bām way·ye·ḥer·ḏū ’îš ’el- ’ā·ḥîw lê·mōr mah- zōṯ ‘ā·śāh ’ĕ·lō·hîm lā·nū
verses.literal: My silver . . . has been returned he said to his brothers It is here in my sack Their hearts sank and trembling they turned to one another and said What is this that God has done to us
verses.literalPt: E disse a seus irmãos: Devolveram o meu dinheiro, e ei-lo também aqui no saco. Então lhes desfaleceu o coração, e pasmavam, dizendo um ao outro: Que é isto que Deus nos tem feito?

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֛אוּ אֶל־ יַעֲקֹ֥ב אֲבִיהֶ֖ם אַ֣רְצָה כְּנָ֑עַן וַיַּגִּ֣ידוּ ל֔וֹ אֵ֛ת כָּל־ הַקֹּרֹ֥ת אֹתָ֖ם לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū ’el- ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’ă·ḇî·hem ’ar·ṣāh kə·nā·‘an way·yag·gî·ḏū lōw ’êṯ kāl- haq·qō·rōṯ ’ō·ṯām lê·mōr
verses.literal: When they reached . . . their father Jacob in the land of Canaan they described to him all that had happened to them
verses.literalPt: E vieram para Jacó, seu pai, na terra de Canaã; e contaram-lhe tudo o que lhes aconteceu, dizendo:

verses.original: דִּ֠בֶּר הָאִ֨ישׁ אֲדֹנֵ֥י הָאָ֛רֶץ אִתָּ֖נוּ קָשׁ֑וֹת וַיִּתֵּ֣ן אֹתָ֔נוּ כִּֽמְרַגְּלִ֖ים אֶת־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: dib·ber hā·’îš ’ă·ḏō·nê hā·’ā·reṣ ’it·tā·nū qā·šō·wṯ way·yit·tên ’ō·ṯā·nū kim·rag·gə·lîm ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: The man who is lord of the land spoke harshly . . . to us and accused us of spying on the country
verses.literalPt: O homem, o senhor da terra, falou conosco asperamente, e tratou-nos como espias da terra;

verses.original: וַנֹּ֥אמֶר אֵלָ֖יו כֵּנִ֣ים אֲנָ֑חְנוּ לֹ֥א הָיִ֖ינוּ מְרַגְּלִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wan·nō·mer ’ê·lāw kê·nîm ’ă·nā·ḥə·nū lō hā·yî·nū mə·rag·gə·lîm
verses.literal: But we told him We are honest men not spies
verses.literalPt: Mas dissemos-lhe: Somos homens de retidão; não somos espias;

verses.original: שְׁנֵים־ עָשָׂ֥ר אֲנַ֛חְנוּ אַחִ֖ים בְּנֵ֣י אָבִ֑ינוּ הָאֶחָ֣ד אֵינֶ֔נּוּ וְהַקָּטֹ֥ן הַיּ֛וֹם אֶת־ אָבִ֖ינוּ בְּאֶ֥רֶץ כְּנָֽעַן׃
verses.transliteration: šə·nêm- ‘ā·śār ’ă·naḥ·nū ’a·ḥîm bə·nê ’ā·ḇî·nū hā·’e·ḥāḏ ’ê·nen·nū wə·haq·qā·ṭōn hay·yō·wm ’eṯ- ’ā·ḇî·nū bə·’e·reṣ kə·nā·‘an
verses.literal: We are twelve . . . brothers sons of one father One is no more and the youngest is now with our father in the land of Canaan
verses.literalPt: Somos doze irmãos, filhos de nosso pai; um não mais existe, e o mais novo está hoje com nosso pai na terra de Canaã.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלֵ֗ינוּ הָאִישׁ֙ אֲדֹנֵ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ בְּזֹ֣את אֵדַ֔ע כִּ֥י כֵנִ֖ים אַתֶּ֑ם אֲחִיכֶ֤ם הָֽאֶחָד֙ הַנִּ֣יחוּ אִתִּ֔י וְאֶת־ רַעֲב֥וֹן בָּתֵּיכֶ֖ם קְח֥וּ וָלֵֽכוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lê·nū hā·’îš ’ă·ḏō·nê hā·’ā·reṣ bə·zōṯ ’ê·ḏa‘ kî ḵê·nîm ’at·tem ’ă·ḥî·ḵem hā·’e·ḥāḏ han·nî·ḥū ’it·tî wə·’eṯ- ra·‘ă·ḇō·wn bāt·tê·ḵem qə·ḥū wā·lê·ḵū
verses.literal: Then the man who is lord of the land said to us This is how I will know whether you are honest Leave one brother with me take food to relieve the hunger of your households and go
verses.literalPt: E aquele homem, o senhor da terra, nos disse: Nisto conhecerei que vós sois homens de retidão; deixai comigo um de vossos irmãos, e tomai para a fome de vossas casas, e parti,

verses.original: וְ֠הָבִיאוּ אֶת־ אֲחִיכֶ֣ם הַקָּטֹן֮ אֵלַי֒ וְאֵֽדְעָ֗ה כִּ֣י לֹ֤א מְרַגְּלִים֙ אַתֶּ֔ם כִּ֥י כֵנִ֖ים אַתֶּ֑ם אֶת־ אֲחִיכֶם֙ אֶתֵּ֣ן לָכֶ֔ם וְאֶת־ הָאָ֖רֶץ תִּסְחָֽרוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·ḇî·’ū ’eṯ- ’ă·ḥî·ḵem haq·qā·ṭōn ’ê·lay wə·’ê·ḏə·‘āh kî lō mə·rag·gə·lîm ’at·tem kî ḵê·nîm ’at·tem ’eṯ- ’ă·ḥî·ḵem ’et·tên lā·ḵem wə·’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ tis·ḥā·rū
verses.literal: But bring your youngest brother back to me so I will know that you are not spies but honest men . . . Then I will give your brother back to you and you can trade in the land
verses.literalPt: E trazei-me vosso irmão mais novo; assim saberei que não sois espias, mas homens de retidão; então vos darei o vosso irmão e negociareis na terra.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י הֵ֚ם מְרִיקִ֣ים שַׂקֵּיהֶ֔ם וְהִנֵּה־ אִ֥ישׁ צְרוֹר־ כַּסְפּ֖וֹ בְּשַׂקּ֑וֹ וַיִּרְא֞וּ אֶת־ צְרֹר֧וֹת כַּסְפֵּיהֶ֛ם הֵ֥מָּה וַאֲבִיהֶ֖ם וַיִּירָֽאוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî hêm mə·rî·qîm śaq·qê·hem wə·hin·nêh- ’îš ṣə·rō·wr- kas·pōw bə·śaq·qōw way·yir·’ū ’eṯ- ṣə·rō·rō·wṯ kas·pê·hem hêm·māh wa·’ă·ḇî·hem way·yî·rā·’ū
verses.literal: As they began emptying their sacks there in each man’s sack was his bag of silver And when they and their father saw the bags of silver they were dismayed
verses.literalPt: E aconteceu que, despejando eles os seus sacos, eis que cada um tinha o pacote com seu dinheiro no seu saco; e viram os pacotes com seu dinheiro, eles e seu pai, e temeram.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵהֶם֙ יַעֲקֹ֣ב אֲבִיהֶ֔ם אֹתִ֖י שִׁכַּלְתֶּ֑ם יוֹסֵ֤ף אֵינֶ֙נּוּ֙ וְשִׁמְע֣וֹן אֵינֶ֔נּוּ וְאֶת־ בִּנְיָמִ֣ן תִּקָּ֔חוּ עָלַ֖י הָי֥וּ כֻלָּֽנָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’ă·ḇî·hem ’ō·ṯî šik·kal·tem yō·w·sêp̄ ’ê·nen·nū wə·šim·‘ō·wn ’ê·nen·nū wə·’eṯ- bin·yā·min tiq·qā·ḥū ‘ā·lay hā·yū ḵul·lā·nāh
verses.literal: Their father Jacob said to them You have deprived me of my sons Joseph is gone and Simeon is no more Now you want to take Benjamin Everything is going against me
verses.literalPt: Então Jacó, seu pai, disse-lhes: Tendes-me desfilhado; José já não existe e Simeão não está aqui; agora levareis a Benjamim. Todas estas coisas vieram sobre mim.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר רְאוּבֵן֙ אֶל־ אָבִ֣יו לֵאמֹ֔ר אֶת־ שְׁנֵ֤י בָנַי֙ תָּמִ֔ית אִם־ לֹ֥א אֲבִיאֶ֖נּוּ אֵלֶ֑יךָ תְּנָ֤ה אֹתוֹ֙ עַל־ יָדִ֔י וַאֲנִ֖י אֲשִׁיבֶ֥נּוּ אֵלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer rə·’ū·ḇên ’el- ’ā·ḇîw lê·mōr ’eṯ- šə·nê ḇā·nay tā·mîṯ ’im- lō ’ă·ḇî·’en·nū ’ê·le·ḵā tə·nāh ’ō·ṯōw ‘al- yā·ḏî wa·’ă·nî ’ă·šî·ḇen·nū ’ê·le·ḵā
verses.literal: Then Reuben said to his father . . . You may kill my two sons if I fail to bring him back to you Put him in my care and I will return him . . .
verses.literalPt: Mas Rúben falou a seu pai, dizendo: Mata os meus dois filhos, se eu não tornar a trazê-lo para ti; entrega-o em minha mão, e tornarei a trazê-lo.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר לֹֽא־ יֵרֵ֥ד בְּנִ֖י עִמָּכֶ֑ם כִּֽי־ אָחִ֨יו מֵ֜ת וְה֧וּא לְבַדּ֣וֹ נִשְׁאָ֗ר וּקְרָאָ֤הוּ אָסוֹן֙ בַּדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֵּֽלְכוּ־ בָ֔הּ וְהוֹרַדְתֶּ֧ם אֶת־ שֵׂיבָתִ֛י בְּיָג֖וֹן שְׁאֽוֹלָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lō- yê·rêḏ bə·nî ‘im·mā·ḵem kî- ’ā·ḥîw mêṯ wə·hū lə·ḇad·dōw niš·’ār ū·qə·rā·’ā·hū ’ā·sō·wn bad·de·reḵ ’ă·šer tê·lə·ḵū- ḇāh wə·hō·w·raḏ·tem ’eṯ- śê·ḇā·ṯî bə·yā·ḡō·wn šə·’ō·w·lāh
verses.literal: But Jacob replied My son will not go down there with you for his brother is dead and he alone is left If any harm comes . . . to him on your . . . . . . journey you will bring my gray hair down to Sheol in sorrow
verses.literalPt: Ele porém disse: Não descerá meu filho convosco; porquanto o seu irmão é morto, e só ele ficou. Se lhe suceder algum desastre no caminho por onde fordes, fareis descer minhas cãs com tristeza à sepultura.
